integrity: Finite cellular and fundamental group calculations are reproduced by embedded code; topological inference uses Hurewicz and Whitehead, no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the full vertex-permutation ordinary quotient for K5 is classified; other n, subgroup quotients and equivariant homotopy types remain unproved; unindexed prior equivalence remains possible.
title: The full vertex-symmetry quotient of the five-vertex forest complex is a homotopy three-sphere
